recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, moody composition featuring a musician in profile at a piano, bathed in a dramatic diagonal spotlight against a dark teal-tinted background. The upper third features a blurred close-up of piano keys overlaid with expressive script and structured sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal spotlight beam cutting through the dark negative space
Juxtaposition of sharp foreground profile against blurred background piano keys
Contrast between fluid script lettering and rigid geometric graphic bars
coreInvariants: Strong diagonal light source from top right
Musician in profile wearing dark glasses and a suit

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Musician positioned in the lower left quadrant, medium shot; piano keys occupy the top third in soft focus.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white spotlight beam in the upper right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the bright spotlight, follows the beam down to the musician, then moves up to the script title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive dark space in the center and left provides breathing room for the typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the light beam and the surrounding darkness.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to teal, white, and a single warm accent color

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Fluid brush script and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Script: High slant, varying stroke weight, connected lowercase, large looped capitals
Sans-serif: All-caps, medium weight, uniform stroke, tight tracking
characterSpecificRedesigns: The script 'R' features a prominent top loop and a long, sweeping tail
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, organic script paired with rigid, industrial sans-serif for a balance of emotion and structure.
graphicDevices: Horizontal orange bars resembling equalizer levels or film strips flanking the top text

preserve: The diagonal slant of the script
avoid: Centered script (keep it slightly offset for dynamism)

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the mid-century expressive handwriting feel
Provides the necessary structural contrast for the header

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic photo of a male soul singer in profile wearing dark glasses and a suit, sitting at a piano. Use a dark teal color grade. A bright diagonal spotlight should shine from the top right. The background should show blurred piano keys in the upper third.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large white brush script title in the upper center. Above it, place a line of all-caps condensed sans-serif text flanked by orange horizontal rectangular bars.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly teal, white, and orange?
Does the spotlight create a clear diagonal path?
Is the script text legible against the blurred piano keys?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the script brush strokes
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the musician's profile is sharp while the piano keys are blurred
Check that the orange bars are perfectly horizontal
Verify the script text has a natural, hand-drawn flow
Confirm the spotlight does not wash out the musician's face details
recipe.reuseFormula: Cinematic Profile + Diagonal Spotlight + Blurred Instrumental Background + Script/Sans-Serif Contrast
